title: Laundry-to-Closet Return Lag
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:cleaning garment_type=* cleaned_epoch=* returned_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((returned_epoch-cleaned_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by garment_type
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures laundry return lag by garment type for laundry turnaround.
value: Lag tracking shows which garment type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside laundry turnaround.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `laundry return lag` on `style:cleaning` events and aggregate them by `garment_type`.
visualization: Table of garment type with average and worst laundry return lag.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how long things take for each garment type so you can see where laundry turnaround slows down.
